name: Combo chart
description: Bars and lines together, with an optional right-hand axis for a measure in a different unit.
aiHints: Use for two related measures over the same categories, for example gift amount as bars and gift count as a line. Measures share the left value axis by default. When one measure is in a different unit or far smaller (a count next to an amount), bind it as {"field": "dataset.measure", "axis": "right"} so it gets its own right-hand axis; otherwise its line looks flat. Use at most one unit per axis.
